errors.says: Multiplication of y by a fixed rational unit costs O(V) by splitting each fiber at Q-a and merging the two pieces in the opposite order.
errors.paper: Splitting at Q-a is the method for the additive shift only. Multiplication by c splits each fiber into c increasing pieces classified by floor(cy/Q) and merges by a residue counter; negation reverses blocks via a stack. The O(V) bound also requires the offset to be computable in b^{O(1)} time.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: two fast tape procedures built on the rank-saving networks (S2), the synthetic transform and ring convolution (S3), resampling with chirp and permutation cancellation (S4), the exact pipeline (S5), and the time table with minimum margin 2κ (S6). It is thinnest on the complex side: the complex network's correctness, the binary orthonormal-basis lemma, the endpoint corrections of the phase interface and the guard-width depth recurrence are asserted rather than derived, and the precision chain is given only through its end values E_s and E_w.

steps.note: The bank exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored, and the three-element subsets, are reconstructed. But the plan never fixes h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3 or m=h^3. m is used throughout without definition, so the network's defining quantities are missing; this is the conservative verdict.
A common frame commutes with a pointwise gate, the network implements D_out S D_in^{-1}, and the motivation says intermediate frames make each edge cheap.
Nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} on gates and terminals, comparable labels on every edge, and the central 3->4 edges as the only decreasing ones, each losing h.
Rank of P_V-P_U equals dim V - dim U; the N source edges with matrix 2P_{U_a} are the rank-one exceptions.
Σ|Δdim|=Wm-2N+2L with L=Ich by telescoping, and s_b=(W_bm-2N+2L_b)+N.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, both below 1/2, give deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, hence s<Wm.
P_{U_a^⊥}+P_{U_a}=I_m on X_a, zero source and identity sink elsewhere, and the physical output Φ_{I_m}f_w: H<-H+D on every row, including scratch rows.
A=E_1ΠE_2 with a ones, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and s recursive calls per node, one per unit of edge rank.
Children of volume V/W, F_k ≤ (s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), and s/W<m^τ with τ=1-2^{-50} from η_b>20·2^{-50} and log m<20, giving F_k=O(e^τ).

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving almost completely: frames, labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget with the N source corrections, L/N below 1/2, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls, and the recurrence with τ=1-2^{-50}. The one gap is at the start: the fixed network's parameters (h=100, N=binom(h,3)^3, m=h^3) are never stated, so C1 is only mentioned although its exchange-and-restore mechanism is present.
